messages:
samir_support: Escalating HorizonX (org: 'horizonx-trial') - bulk ingest failing with intermittent 429s and clients seeing unexpected charges due to retries. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-6219
maya_cs: Thanks Samir. Is activation blocked? Any privacy or data concerns?
samir_support: Activation blocked for the bulk job. No data loss. Their job used parallelism=24 which tripped a tenant cap bug. SDK v2.5.3. Region: us-east-1.
joel_csm: I'll own customer comms. Proposed: immediate ack + billing hold request + short workaround + 10am PT bridge with eng. Also want daily 15m check-ins until green.
anya_eng: Triage: router respected global cap only after recent config rollout; tenant caps weren't applied correctly for some orgs. Hotfix ready to canary that reapplies tenant limits and adds a soft-throttle. Canary ETA ~40m, full roll ~2h if healthy.
finance_bot: Billing hold requires revenue_ops approval; tagging @revenue_ops. Trials under $500 can get pre-approved credit.
maya_cs: Draft comm to PM: 1) Acknowledge & apology (now) 2) Workaround: rerun import with concurrency=8 OR use resumable uploader 3) Were requesting a temporary billing hold while we investigate 4) 10am PT bridge + hourly updates 5) If >6h, offer onboarding credit and a dedicated onboarding engineer.
joel_csm: Sending the note now. Also including ops snippet for their SREs - @anya_eng please confirm syntax.
anya_eng: Ops snippet:
```
# reduced concurrency import
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/import -H "Authorization: Bearer <KEY>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"source":"s3://bucket/path","concurrency":8}'
```
Alternative: add header `X-Force-SoftThrottle: true` to enable server-side queueing.
samir_support: Ticket updated with workaround and monitoring rules: watch router.429.rate and tenant.retry_spike. Muted client auto-retries while we monitor.
maya_cs: Flagging renewal_risk=ELEVATED if not resolved within 24h. Posting hourly status updates in this thread. :thumbsup:
